stem_book: A particle starts from rest at t = 0 and undergoes an acceleration a in m s⁻² with time t in seconds which is as shown (graph). Which one of the following plots represents velocity v in m s⁻¹ versus time t in seconds? (a) graph (A) (b) graph (B) (c) graph (C) (d) graph (D) — the four v–t graphs are shown in the figure
key: A triangle peaking at 6 m/s at t = 2 s
derived: a triangle rising to 6 m/s at t = 2 s and back to 0 at t = 4 s
correct_answer: a (triangle peaking at 6 m/s at t = 2 s, zero at t = 4 s)
reason: Manifest stem describes the graphs in text; options are drawings — use the figure.
work: v(2) = 3·2 = 6 m/s, then v(4) = 6 − 3·2 = 0, linear both ways → triangle
